name: Development of eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerves
reason: Members cover eye (optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid, optic nerve), inner ear (otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal), cranial ganglia/nerves and taste papillae: all cranial sensory organ development.

name: NAD+ / nicotinate metabolism and salvage
reason: All members are pyridine nucleotide (NAD) metabolism: nicotinate metabolism, NAD salvage and NAD+ catabolism.

name: Platelet adhesion via VWF-GPIb and collagen-GPVI
reason: VWF/GPIb-IX-V variants, ADAMTS13 cleavage, GPVI collagen signalling and platelet aggregation dominate; collagen trimerization, laminin and integrin interactions are related matrix-adhesion context.

name: Small GTPase cycles and regulation (atypical RHO, RAS, Ral)
reason: Most members are small GTPase cycles/effectors (RHOBTB1-3, RHOH, rhotekin, KTN1, RAS processing, Ral) and GTPase activity regulation; KLF12 targets and 'regulation of localization' are odd minorities.

name: Oxidative stress defence and redox homeostasis
reason: ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, oxidative protein repair (methionine sulfoxide reduction) and ferroptosis suppression share antioxidant defence.

name: Synapse assembly and trans-synaptic adhesion
reason: All members concern synapse formation/maturation, receptor clustering (NMDA, GABA-A, gephyrin, PSD-95), synaptic adhesion molecules (neurexins/neuroligins, NCAM, RPTPs) and synaptic transmission tuning.

name: Wnt/beta-catenin signalling and destruction complex defects
reason: Hallmark Wnt/beta-catenin plus AXIN1 and APC mutant destruction-complex disruption.

name: Mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint
reason: Spindle checkpoint regulation, MAD2 kinetochore signalling and mitotic chromosome localization all concern mitotic SAC.

name: Cilia, centrosome and microtubule organization
reason: Ciliogenesis/IFT/axoneme, motile cilia (sperm, airway, ependymal CSF flow), photoreceptor connecting cilium, and centrosome/spindle/tubulin modification sub-themes are linked by centriole-basal body and microtubule machinery; a few odd members (organ identity, actin localization).

name: AMPA receptor clustering and synaptic trapping
reason: All members concern AMPA/glutamate receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and activity regulation.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA and RNA processing
reason: Mitochondrial tRNA 5' leader removal, 3'-end processing, modification and RNA import are mitochondrial RNA maturation.

name: Neural plate border, neural crest and hindbrain patterning
reason: AP-2 family regulation, neural plate border/neural crest specification, anterior/posterior neural plate, rhombomere and MHB boundaries and axis specification form early neural/embryonic patterning; one generic signal transduction member.

name: Cadherin trafficking, turnover and interactions
reason: CDH1 processing/trafficking and degradation plus CDH11 interactions: classical cadherin biology.

name: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
reason: NHEJ (classical/alternative), HR regulation, DSB sensing and ATM signalling at breaks.

name: Glycerol, polyol and fructose metabolism
reason: Glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism with fructose formation via the polyol pathway.

name: Sphingomyelin-ceramide metabolism and regulation
reason: Sphingomyelin catabolism, TNFR1 ceramide production and regulation of sphingolipid/ceramide synthesis and homeostasis.

name: Rab GTPase prenylation and activation
reason: Rab geranylgeranylation, Rab GEFs and Rab signalling with Rab-dependent Golgi-lysosome transport.

name: CNS myelination and glial responses
reason: Oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation, CNS myelin formation/maintenance/regulation and reactive gliosis; 'neuronal signal transduction' is a vague outlier.

name: DNA replication initiation and lagging-strand synthesis
reason: Primer synthesis, polymerase switching, flap removal, elongation and polymerase activity regulation.

name: Gastrulation: endoderm and lateral mesoderm formation
reason: Primitive streak, definitive endoderm, lateral plate mesoderm and gut tube morphogenesis; 'cell development' is generic.

name: Fc-gamma receptor signalling and phagocytosis
reason: FCGR activation, ADCC, Fc-mediated phagocytic cup actin dynamics and phospholipid signalling.

name: Urate transport and renal hypouricemia
reason: Urate metabolism/transport and URAT1/GLUT9 defects causing renal hypouricemia.

name: TNFR1 signalling to NF-kB and apoptosis
reason: TNFR1-induced NF-kB and proapoptotic signalling, linear ubiquitination (LUBAC) and canonical NF-kB activation.

name: Glucuronate-xylulose pathway and pentosuria
reason: Glucuronate catabolism to xylulose-5-phosphate, pentose metabolism and essential pentosuria.

name: Presynaptic regulation of neurotransmitter release and uptake
reason: Neurotransmitter uptake, secretion and spontaneous transmission are presynaptic modulation of neurotransmission.

name: RhoA activation via G12/13 and Sema4D-plexin signalling
reason: G12/13-RhoGEF signalling, Sema4D/plexin-B growth cone collapse and RND1 all converge on Rho regulation of migration.

name: Lipoxin and HETE eicosanoid biosynthesis
reason: Lipoxygenase products of arachidonate: 5-/15-HETE derivatives and lipoxins in inflammation.

name: Propionyl-CoA catabolism and methylmalonic acidemia
reason: Propionyl-CoA catabolism and MUT/MMAA/MMAB defects causing MMA.

name: Fibroblast ECM remodelling and mechanoresponsive stromal programme
reason: Collagen synthesis/crosslinking/degradation, ECM proteoglycans, integrins, TGF-beta, SRF/YAP-TAZ mechanoresponse and fibroblast/stromal BTMs dominate; small minority off-theme (miRNA, B-cell TBA, fibrinogen levels).

name: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium
reason: HNF4/CDX enterocyte-hepatocyte modules and HNF-enriched modules; 'leukocyte migration' is a lone outlier.

name: IL-6 family cytokine signalling via STAT
reason: Core is IL-6-type cytokines (IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) and STAT activation; chemokine cluster, IFN-alpha response, autocrine/paracrine signalling and receptor binding regulation are loosely attached.

name: Lysosomal glycoconjugate catabolism and storage disorders
reason: Lysosomal oligosaccharide, ganglioside and glycosphingolipid catabolism with sialidosis/GM2 gangliosidosis defects and lysosomal enzyme secretion; MAN1B1 a minor outlier.

name: HIV early life cycle: entry to reverse transcription
reason: HIV binding/entry, uncoating and minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal blood pressure regulation
reason: Angiotensin metabolism/signalling, blood volume, renal sodium/filtration, vasoconstriction, drinking and peptide catabolism all serve blood pressure homeostasis.

name: DNA excision, mismatch repair and translesion synthesis
reason: BER, NER, MMR, TLS and repair synthesis, with linked replication polymerase steps and somatic hypermutation; TCF7L2 mutants an outlier.

name: Lipoprotein metabolism and cholesterol transport
reason: Chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodelling and clearance, cholesterol efflux, ABC lipid transporters and intestinal lipid absorption.

name: Pulmonary surfactant metabolism and its disorders
reason: Surfactant metabolism/homeostasis and SFTP/ABCA3/CSF2R defects, plus airway mucus and hyperoxia response.

name: Lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism
reason: Ganglioside/glucosylceramide catabolism in the lysosome and GM2 gangliosidosis.

name: HIV Nef-mediated downregulation of surface receptors
reason: Nef downregulation of MHC-I, CD4, CD8 and CD28.

name: HPA axis: ACTH and glucocorticoid secretion and response
reason: Corticotropin and glucocorticoid secretion, cortisol/corticosterone/dexamethasone response and POMC deficiency.
